contracts.contract: Stable identity, caller children, neutral centered geometry
contracts.remaining: Base is a semantic reducer, not an automatic styled box. Caller layout is explicit; composed paint preserves one semantic and expanded/controls metadata.

contracts.contract: Selected/disabled state refinements and instance-style priority
contracts.current_api: cui_interaction + caller layout; styled selected/custom colors
contracts.remaining: No general StyleRefinement chain or independent disabled palette override. Existing flat palette tests do not prove upstream style replay priority.

contracts.contract: Role override and explicit accessible name
contracts.remaining: Core setter supports role override after registration; no Button option duplicates it. Native AT interpretation is not established by semantic unit tests.

contracts.contract: Caller focus handle, tab stop, focusability
contracts.remaining: No GPUI handle/entity types in portable API. Styled skip_tab and pointer-focus opt-out exist; Base focusable(false) semantics need composition-specific proof.

contracts.contract: Ordered signed tab_index
contracts.remaining: Traversal uses previous semantic order, not ordered indexes. A positive public semantic field is not a supported setter or ordering implementation.

contracts.contract: Mouse and Enter/Space activation, disabled blocking of parent
contracts.remaining: Inert child does not activate itself, but parent activates for disabled/loading mouse/touch. Requires opt-in activation blocker; see proposal.

contracts.contract: Variants Default/Primary/Secondary/Danger/Warning/Success/Info/Ghost/Link/Text/Custom; outline orthogonal
contracts.current_api: 12 enum variants including legacy OUTLINE + outline flag
contracts.remaining: Names and solid states covered; gradients/Oklab/shadow remain separate gaps. Zero CUI option remains legacy Primary, unlike upstream Default; intentional compatibility difference.

contracts.contract: Theme background tokens, semantic outline depth, gradients
contracts.remaining: No automatic gradient backgrounds/semantic gradient opacity states. A generic mesh renderer is not a Button token implementation.

contracts.contract: Custom normal/foreground/hover/active plus shadow
contracts.remaining: Resolved palettes work; source custom shadow and Oklab transparent mixing absent. Built-in variants do not request shadow: do not invent mandatory shadows for all buttons.

contracts.contract: XS/S/M/L, custom pixel sizing, compact, centered icon/text
contracts.remaining: Legacy dimensions and centering covered. Custom size is split into explicit C fields, and callback content needs caller constraints. Explicit width intentionally clips.

contracts.contract: All 14 design sizes and density
contracts.status: headless tested; responsive marker proof exists
contracts.remaining: 432 size/variant/density containment cases use plain label and two named SVGs. The Button-specific browser suite has 11 baseline cases. Responsive gallery tests cover all14 sizes/both densities at390/1280 but assert only that Loading text exists and its bottom fits canvas height. They do not prove every card-local label/icon/slot clip containment or activation at those scales; generic design-size family list omits standalone Button.

contracts.contract: None/Small/Medium/Large/custom rounding
contracts.remaining: Custom radius is exercised; independent draw-radius/state matrix for every rounding mode is not established by that test.

contracts.contract: Normal/hover/pressed/selected colors
contracts.remaining: Actual browser hover/pressed changes and headless custom colors are covered; source gradient/state styling and group hover are not.

contracts.contract: selected and open are separate presentation states; toggled explicit semantics
contracts.remaining: Standalone options have no separate open field. Host can derive selected paint from open and preserve expanded metadata, but dedicated selected/open transitions are not fully proven. Selected does not imply checked.

contracts.contract: Disabled/loading inertness, normal 0.8 loading opacity, busy semantics
contracts.remaining: Self activation suppressed and actual loading SVG/reduced motion covered; parent-blocking fails. Arbitrary caller child semantics remain caller-owned.

contracts.contract: Default loading Spinner/custom loading Icon
contracts.remaining: Loading named glyph rotation/reduced motion tested. Full custom loading asset/state/size/geometry browser matrix absent.

contracts.contract: Icon/Spinner/ProgressCircle typed slot; loading preserves explicit Spinner/Progress
contracts.remaining: Slot precedence supports composition, but the current test uses colored boxes, not actual persistent ProgressCircle/Spinner across loading states. No typed ButtonIcon discriminator API is required to match paint behavior.

contracts.contract: Label, icon-only, appended children, content clipping and centering
contracts.remaining: Source appends arbitrary children; legacy replacement content remains compatible. Slot dimensions/colors/semantics are caller-owned. Every all14-size rich slot is not browser-tested.

contracts.contract: Ellipsis preserves full accessible label
contracts.remaining: Plain UTF-8 grapheme truncation and buffer exhaustion tested. Buffer-limited clipping differs from unconstrained upstream storage; rich child truncation/shaping is not promised.

contracts.contract: Dropdown caret and leading artwork
contracts.remaining: Three actual SVG commands fit baseline icon button; no exhaustive native pixel/size/caret matrix.

contracts.contract: on_click event callback and exact per-event multiplicity
contracts.remaining: Two queued click sequences retain two Core event activations but produce one callback/bool result. Existing tests establish one callback per activated frame across frames. No ClickEvent argument; event metadata is available through Core frame events.

contracts.contract: Interactive on_hover edges
contracts.remaining: State ownership/reset documented; basic edges tested. New presence/leave handling is Core-tested, but Button-specific stationary leave/reenter and disable-during-hover callback matrix lacks direct browser proof.

contracts.contract: Focus ring opt-out, pointer-focus suppression, keyboard focus
contracts.remaining: Source styled pointer-down prevents default; CUI preserves legacy pointer focus unless opt-in. Ring currently uses 2px theme focus border rather than source Inside/Edge/Outside focus-line policy.

contracts.contract: Tooltip plain text, preferred placement, lifecycle
contracts.remaining: Focus/open/Escape/cancel/disabled and description are tested. All side collision placements and focus/mouse/touch browser lifecycle on Button are not fully proven.

contracts.contract: Tooltip with action/context keybinding
contracts.current_api: no action registry or keybinding tooltip option
contracts.remaining: Plain text containing a shortcut is not automatic action/context lookup.

contracts.contract: Arbitrary tooltip builder
contracts.status: not a public pinned Button requirement
contracts.remaining: Pinned field and render branch exist, but no public setter is present in this Button source. Treat a future arbitrary builder as an extension, not invented completeness criterion.

contracts.contract: Accessibility developer string id, role/name/toggled, platform actions
contracts.current_api: numeric stable IDs; semantic role/name/checked; optional native bridge
contracts.remaining: Numeric identity is portable; no separate developer string identifier. Metadata/unit dispatch is not physical Windows/macOS/Linux AT certification or every browser aria mapping.

contracts.contract: Base supplied by compounds and complete child paint
contracts.remaining: Painting preserves caller semantics and is non-activating. Upstream private with_base is not a public C API requirement. No previous-frame bitmap approximation is used for ordinary button children.

contracts.contract: Connected edge/corner masks, hover-group held/open
contracts.current_api: Dropdown has local corner helpers; no shared Button masks/hover group
contracts.remaining: Private upstream hooks matter to ButtonGroup/split compounds, not standalone public builder completeness. Local Dropdown shape does not supply a reusable ButtonGroup implementation.

contracts.contract: Collection identity/children, horizontal/vertical connected layout
contracts.remaining: No cui_button_group. ToggleGroup does not preserve per-child full Button options, callback behavior or connected Button border topology.

contracts.contract: Optional inherited size/variant/compact/outline
contracts.remaining: Requires explicit inheritance/override contract without mutating caller data; all14 scales are additional user work.

contracts.contract: Controlled rendered selection, single/multiple requested index collection
contracts.current_api: ToggleGroup emits bool arrays with different semantics
contracts.remaining: Source derives selected indices from rendered child selected flags, emits request, does not persist selection itself; children expose toggled state.

contracts.contract: Group callback replaces child callback; absent group preserves child
contracts.remaining: Do not equate callback replacement with simultaneously firing both callbacks. Requires exactly defined ownership and meaningful reject/accept tests.

contracts.contract: Legacy keyboard callback and disabled builder-order edges
contracts.remaining: Pinned tests deliberately show keyboard click never reaches group callback and disabled-after-child leaves child callback active. A new C API should document intentional corrections rather than claim byte-for-byte parity or invent roving arrow requirements.

contracts.contract: Complete named catalog/default assets/native and WASM loading
contracts.remaining: Counts match source asset description. Upstream WASM on-demand CDN is not an implicit CUI dependency; host loader/full embed required. Default unbundled names explicitly NOT_FOUND; no silent fallback claim.

contracts.contract: Path/raw copied SVG replacement, empty, source sharing/view
contracts.remaining: Copied source replacement/lifetime tested. No GPUI Entity/View or shared clone API; explicit independent state/resources are portable replacements.

contracts.contract: Inherited color/text size, XS/S/M/L/custom, explicit width/height precedence
contracts.remaining: Explicit theme/text override supported; automatic global text-style scope inheritance absent. Icon design-size geometry has unit proof; native font/theme scope browser matrix remains partial.

contracts.contract: Affine transform/rotate paint overflow without changing layout
contracts.remaining: Actual alpha/centroid/overflow tests exist. Full upstream transform/SVG renderer equivalence is not established.

contracts.contract: Paint-only decorative layout and ownership/cache bounds
contracts.remaining: No focus/role added. Borrowed immutable masks retained until collect; bounded limits intentional. Caller state is not thread-safe or safely memcpy-clonable.

contracts.contract: SVG renderer feature coverage and actual native pixels
contracts.current_api: Pinned NanoSVG monochrome mask; portable image command
contracts.remaining: Not full resvg/SVG CSS/text/filter/external-image parity. All embedded assets rasterize in configured unit builds; inspected tests do not certify every physical renderer/AT platform.

contracts.contract: Custom per-control named cursor and RGBA pointer images
contracts.current_api: custom_cursor/cui_set_cursor; SDL system cursors; browser CSS
contracts.remaining: Hand/crosshair cases tested; SDL grab/zoom/help use documented fallbacks, no caller RGBA cursor+hotspot adapter. Generic queued SDL normalization is not actual Button end-to-end physical touch proof.

contracts.contract: Error state, URL navigation, spring Button animation, roving group arrows
contracts.remaining: Error wording exists in the ledger but no standalone error builder/state is present. Link is a role/visual variant, not automatic URL navigation. Do not import Checkbox motion or RadioGroup arrow requirements.

temporary_public_api_probes: disabled/loading mouse/touch parent activates once, child zero
two queued clicks: event activations2, callbacks1, bool1
